harness.config: Harbor opencode agent; provider = local OpenAI-compatible llama.cpp server; permission external_directory allow.

execution.command: harbor run -p terminal-bench-2-1 -i <task> -a opencode -m local/local -n 1 (one task at a time, see run-alt.sh)

runs.notes: 54/89 solved; 20 wrong, 12 time limit, 1 agent crash, 2 not run. Local single-GPU run: RTX 5090 32 GB, llama.cpp 2145525a4 (CUDA 13.2) serving unsloth Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL with lossless speculative decoding (ngram-mod + DFlash2 draft), 262k context, q8_0 KV, sampling temp 1.0 / top-p 0.95 / top-k 20, reasoning effort medium. One server slot, one task at a time; opencode and Codex alternated on the same tasks in a fixed random order (seed 42). Harbor 0.23.0 with harness defaults (no instruction files). 2 tasks (qemu-startup, qemu-alpine-ssh) could not run because the agent install needs Node.js and the task image's apt fails; counted as failures. Per-task outcomes and scripts in the artifact repo; full trajectories not published (they contain a throwaway server key).

One server slot, one task at a time; opencode and Codex alternated on the same tasks in a fixed random order (seed 42). Harbor 0.23.0 with harness defaults (no instruction files). 2 tasks (qemu-startup, qemu-alpine-ssh) could not run because the agent install needs Node.js and the task image's apt fails; counted as failures. Per-task outcomes and scripts in the artifact repo; full trajectories not published (they contain a throwaway server key).
